title: 6. Man vvas created to declare the Iuſtice and mercy of god.

segments.text: THere ſhalbe ſome •aue• and ſome damned, & all for the glorye of god, as the whole Scripture dothe declare. It foloweth then that for as much as nothing doth happen or come to paſſe at auēture or by chance, & that god doth neuer chaunge hys purpoſe nor mynde, and god hathe not onelye foreſéene but alſo eternally ordained to create man to ſprede for the and declare his glorye a in ſauing b by his grace thoſe which pleaſeth him, forgetting nothing appart•yning to his iuſtice without the which he cannot be god, and c condemning other by his iuſt Iudgement.
